# Menu

<!-- MAP:START (generated by .kiro/scripts/build-docs.py from rp-map.json) -->
**`rp-menu`** = `Menu` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/Menu` · Figma: Menu

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-menu-item` | MenuItem |
| `rp-menu-item-secondary` | MenuItem secondary text |
| `rp-menu-group-label` | MenuGroup / ListSubheader |
| `rp-menu-divider` | Divider |
| `rp-menu-header` | menu header (user menu) |
| `rp-menu-search` | search field inside the menu |
| `rp-menu-item-selected` | MenuItem selected |
| `rp-menu-item-disabled` | MenuItem disabled |
| `rp-menu-item-danger` | destructive item (red) |
| `rp-menu-fixed` | positioned at its trigger (runtime) |
| `rp-menu-item-focused` | keyboard focus (runtime) |
<!-- MAP:END -->

One menu element per kind of action, shared by every trigger that points at it (`data-rp-menu="rowMenu"`). shared.js opens it below the trigger (above when there is no room), closes it on an item click, an outside click, Tab or Escape, and moves with arrow keys.

```html
<button type="button" class="rp-icon-button" data-rp-menu="rowMenu" aria-label="More actions"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-actions"></span></button>

<div class="rp-menu" id="rowMenu" role="menu" aria-label="User actions">
  <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item" role="menuitem" data-rp-open="userDrawer"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-edit"></span> Edit user</button>
  <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item" role="menuitem" data-rp-snackbar="Password reset email sent"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-password"></span> Reset password</button>
  <div class="rp-menu-divider"></div>
  <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item rp-menu-item-danger" role="menuitem" data-rp-open="deleteDialog"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-delete"></span> Delete user</button>
</div>
```
- Put page menus at the end of `<body>`, after `</main>`.
- `data-rp-align-right` aligns the menu with the right edge of its trigger (top bar menus).
- `data-rp-selectable` on the menu marks the clicked item selected and copies its text (or `data-rp-value`) into the trigger's `[data-rp-menu-label]` element (establishment and date range selectors).
- `.rp-menu-search` (an input inside the menu) filters its items. `rp-menu-group-label` titles a group, `rp-menu-header` holds the user name in the account menu.
- Item labels: a verb or verb + noun in sentence case ("Edit user", "Download report").
